descriptionChirho: A human male or the male sex, used both of individual males and of the category 'male' in contrast to 'female.' Singular and plural forms represent the same lexical meaning with only grammatical number variation. Multilingual evidence consistently renders a single concept: spa 'varón/varones,' hin 'नर/पुरुषों,' arb 'ذَكَرًا/ذُكورٍ,' kor '남자/남자들,' swa 'mwanaume/wanaume.' Used in contexts of male children (Rev 12:5, Matt 19:4), homosexual relations (Rom 1:27), and gender distinction (Gal 3:28).
